profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, China, trading on NASDAQ under the ticker EH. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001759783. The company describes itself as a leading autonomous aerial vehicle technology platform company, with a mission to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone.

According to its website, EHang provides autonomous aerial vehicle products and commercial solutions in urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media solutions. It lists product areas covering passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions. The company describes itself as a forerunner of AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global urban air mobility industry.

The available record lists no litigation involving the company.
